compiler.name: AMD Vitis HLS
compiler.evidence: Coroni synthesis receipts and Vitis logs for the authenticated 2026-11-05 GAN/Kalman diagnostic batch

limit_interpretation.multidimensional_dim_zero: product of extents because HLS dim=0 partitions all dimensions
limit_interpretation.nonzero_dimension: extent of the selected source dimension; other dimensions remain array dimensions
limit_interpretation.boundary: reject only when selected partition element count is greater than 1024
limit_interpretation.confidence: conservative compiler-specific guard; exact internal XFORM accounting for multidimensional arrays is not independently established

partial_partition_rule: block/cyclic factor must be positive and no larger than the selected dimension extent
source_tuple_rule: array type, factor sentinel, and dimension must extend to one complete SourceAction tuple

evidence.observation: Vitis 2021.1 rejected explicit complete partitioning of one-dimensional 262144-element Kalman arrays and reported threshold 1024 under the recorded runner configuration
Vitis 2021.1 rejected block factor 64 for GAN layer_2_out with source extent 50
UG1399 documents complete partitioning per selected dimension, factor semantics, and dim=0 as partitioning all dimensions
UG1448 identifies complete partitioning arrays larger than 1024 as a long-runtime risk; this is guidance, not a universal silicon/resource limit

limitations: The 1024 guard is specific to the authenticated Vitis 2021.1 runner profile and its observed XFORM diagnostic; it is not a universal FPGA capacity limit.

Multidimensional threshold accounting uses the selected dimension extent, consistent with documented dim semantics, but the internal 2021.1 XFORM counting behavior for all shapes requires a targeted compiler probe.
The config_array_partition complete_threshold setting describes automatic partitioning and is not treated as changing the explicit-directive XFORM rejection boundary.
This policy prevents known invalid choices; it does not guarantee HLS success, resource-budget feasibility, or timing closure.
